evidence: New Resume creates 'Untitled Resume' in editor with blank contact fields, blank summary (0/500), empty experience list; editable immediately.

actual: Set experience start-date=2020-01 and end-date=2019-01 (end before start). No validation error or feedback appeared; the field accepted the value and the preview rendered 'Jan 2020 - Jan 2019' as if valid.

evidence: Experience and education start/end dates are both native type=month inputs (consistent YYYY-MM format), rendered in preview as 'Mon YYYY'. Checking 'I currently work here' on an experience entry cleared and disabled its End Date field, and preview showed 'Jan 2020 - Present'.

Contact fields and summary editable and reflected in preview; experience entries can be added, edited, reordered (move-up/down changed preview order), and removed; education entries same; skills can be added, level changed via combobox, and removed.

Switched template from Modern -> Classic -> Minimal via Template tab; each switch updated 'selected' state and preview styling (e.g. uppercase headings in Classic/Minimal) while all contact, summary, experience, education and skills content remained intact.

Typing into contact/summary/experience/education/skills fields immediately updated the live preview values (e.g. contact name/email, summary text, experience dates/company) with no save or refresh action required; template switch also reflected instantly.

issue: Customized section headings not rendered in all applicable styles
actual: Sections tab allows customizing the Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, and Skills headings. Renamed Experience heading to 'Career History' and it correctly appeared in Modern, Classic, and Minimal previews. However, renaming the Summary heading to 'About Me' never appeared in the Minimal style preview even though the summary text itself was visible there (it did appear correctly in Modern and Classic). Additionally the customizable Contact section heading ('Contact Information') is never rendered in the preview in any of the three styles.

evidence: Sections tab lists Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills with move-up/down and visibility toggle per section, plus an editable heading. Moved Education above Experience (preview order changed accordingly) and toggled Skills visibility off/on (section disappeared/reappeared in preview).

Reordering (Education moved above Experience) and hiding/showing the Skills section updated the live preview immediately without save/refresh; layout change persisted while navigating between editor tabs during the session.

Clicked 'Hide Preview' - preview region disappeared, editor content (contact fields) remained intact and editable. Clicked 'Show Preview' again - preview reappeared with all content and the Minimal template styling still applied.

Added 5 more experience entries (6 total) plus existing education and skills content, exceeding the viewport (body scrollHeight 2462px vs window 720px). All visible sections (summary, all 6 experience entries with full descriptions, education, skills) rendered with their content, and scrolling (scrollIntoView on the last experience entry) successfully brought it into the readable viewport - confirming the whole resume remains accessible via scroll.

Renamed resume title in editor to 'Senior Engineer Application Resume' via editor.title; editor immediately reflected the new title, and after navigating back to dashboard the resume card also displayed 'Senior Engineer Application Resume'.

After editing contact/summary/experience/education/skills across multiple editor tabs, navigating back to dashboard, the resume card 'Senior Engineer Application Resume' showed 'Updated Aug 25, 2026' (today), reflecting the update. Reopening the resume in the next step will further confirm content retention.

After editing all content areas, returning to dashboard, and reopening the resume, contact details, summary, all 5 experience entries, education entry, and both skills were all still present exactly as entered.

Duplicated 'Senior Engineer Application Resume' via card menu -> Duplicate, producing 'Senior Engineer Application Resume (Copy)'. Renamed the copy to 'Product Manager Application Resume' and edited its Full Name to 'Jane Copy-Doe' without affecting the source resume.

Edited copy's Full Name to 'Jane Copy-Doe' - original still shows 'Jane Doe'. Edited original's Phone to '555-999-0000' - copy still shows original phone '555-123-4567'. Changes in each do not propagate to the other.

Dashboard now lists 5 distinct resume variations created/managed in this session: 'Senior Engineer Application Resume', 'Product Manager Application Resume' (duplicate), plus the 3 pre-existing seed resumes, each independently editable.

issue: No validation feedback shown for empty/whitespace rename
actual: Tested two rename paths: (1) inline editor title - entered whitespace-only value and pressed Enter, title correctly reverted to the previous non-empty title; (2) dashboard card 'Rename' dialog - cleared the title field to empty and clicked Save, the dialog closed and the card title correctly remained 'Product Manager Application Resume'. In both cases the title was correctly NOT changed, but no error message, toast, or inline validation text ever appeared to inform the user why the rename was rejected - the notifications region stayed empty and no console warnings were logged.

Dashboard only offers a title search textbox and a sort dropdown (Newest/Oldest/Title A-Z/Title Z-A). There is no date picker, exact-date filter, or date-range filter control anywhere on the dashboard. Typing a date string (e.g. 'Feb 10, 2024') into the search box only matches against resume titles, returning 'No resumes found' since it does not match the date field - confirming the search box does not support date filtering either.

evidence: Searching 'marketing' (lowercase) matched 'Marketing Manager Resume' and 'RESUME' (uppercase) matched all titles containing 'Resume' - confirming case-insensitive title search. Sort dropdown 'Oldest First' reordered cards from Jan 20 2024 to Aug 25 2026 ascending; 'Newest First' reverses it. Clearing the search box restored all 5 resumes.

issue: Created/edited/duplicated/renamed resumes are lost on reload
actual: Before reload, dashboard had 4 resumes: the 3 original seed resumes plus 'Senior Engineer Application Resume' (a resume created, extensively edited, and renamed during this session; its duplicate 'Product Manager Application Resume' had just been deleted). After reloading the app (navigating to http://localhost:6005/), the dashboard showed only the 3 original seed resumes ('Product Designer Resume', 'Marketing Manager Resume', 'Software Engineer Resume') - the created/edited/renamed 'Senior Engineer Application Resume' was completely gone. All in-session created and edited resume data is lost on reload; only the app's original seed data persists.
